preparedSources.food: Chicken biryani made with basmati rice
preparedSources.sourcePreparation: Restaurant basmati rice with boiled chicken; rice,salt,ghee,spices,chicken,garlic,onion. Bought previous day and heated on test morning. Exact recipe ratios and storage temperature not reported.
preparedSources.limits: Whole mixed-food observation, never standalone rice GI. Reference testCHO was calculated by difference. Yogurt/oil quantity and layered cooking differ in the proposed version; analogical GI error is not quantified. SEM not used as recipe interval.

preparedSources.food: Steamed stuffed bun with shallots and meat
preparedSources.locator: Yang2006 Table2:39.1±13.0SD,n10; rounded39 in Atkinson2021 Table1/2048,p136
preparedSources.sourcePreparation: Chinese steamed meat/shallot stuffed bun; source reports usual traditional preparation, without exact recipe ratios.
preparedSources.limits: Use standardized table value39. Original39.1SD13.0 is recorded, not a recipe confidence interval. Cabbage,seasoning ratios and fermentation losses are not characterized; input-derivedCHO is a nominal recipe model. This is not raw flour,pork,soy sauce or plain mantou GI.

preparedSources.sourcePreparation: Named commercial pizza base baked220C9min; exact historical product formulation not supplied.
preparedSources.limits: B analogue only for a baked wheat pizza-base component. Home dough hydration,fermentation,formulation and250C7–10min differ. Toppings have their own source assignments; no measured Margherita GI claim and no raw-flour GI52.

preparedSources.sourcePreparation: Plain lacy wheat pancake, tested alone,3h glucose reference; exact batter ingredient quantities unavailable in accessed abstract/table.
preparedSources.limits: Only the pancake component uses49. The same study reports81 for a meal with chicken/potato/coconut curry; never present49 as measured whole-plate GI. Proposed egg/coconut batter ratios and curry differ. Type2 cohort and3h protocol limit transfer; analogical error unquantified.

preparedSources.sourcePreparation: 75.2g commercial premix cooked in235g boiling water,stirred3min. Ingredients semolina,vegetable oil,salt,urad dal and green chilli.
preparedSources.limits: Whole semolina-upma comparison, not semolina ingredient GI. Proposed peas/carrot/fresh curry leaves replace source dal/chilli profile and no oil is added. Grain/boiling form match; exact matrix differs materially. This named-reference point is not a validated estimate for every upma.

preparedSources.food: Steamed gelatinized wheat semolina with groundnut oil
preparedSources.sourcePreparation: Wheat semolina steamed/gelatinized with5g groundnut oil; source reference dose50gCHO. Source does not establish67g as a dry-flour yield conversion.
preparedSources.limits: Older type2 n6,three sample times,reference not repeated. Proposed6.4g rapeseed oil per63.6g native componentCHO approximates reported5g fat/50g testCHO; fat type and preparation details differ. Source steaming versus proposed water-boiled porridge is an additional preparation difference. Oil addition is a new content decision. Not an oil-free porridge GI or raw flour GI.

fruitSources.limitation: Named cultivar reference. Australian dried-date composition is a proxy; test-stage moisture/cultivar differences unquantified.
Raw edible orange segments only; no automatic cooked citrus analogue.
